title: In Progress® Telerik® Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027, uncontrolled recursion, infinite…
description: A vulnerability in In Progress® Telerik® Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027 allows unauthenticated attackers to cause uncontrolled recursion, infinite loops, and inefficient resource allocation. This can lead to termination or hanging of the host process when processing crafted PDF documents or document text submitted for summarization or question answering.
